# STARVNT — Plan Your Wedding & Events

> Plan weddings, celebrations and corporate events with STARVNT. Discover event professionals, review quotations and manage your event journey.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://starvnt.com/): Public STARVNT introduction.
- [Privacy](https://starvnt.com/privacy): Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://starvnt.com/terms): Terms of service.

## Account access

Account workspaces require sign-in. Private customer, vendor and admin records are not public resources.
